title: The Internet's Own Boy: The Story of Aaron Swartz | full movie (2014)
summary: The full documentary 'The Internet's Own Boy' about programmer and activist Aaron Swartz, with interviews with family, friends and internet figures. It covers his work on access to information and the legal case preceding his death.
why: HN recommends it as the essential documentary for learning about Aaron Swartz and the case that shaped hacker culture.

quote.text: here's a must-watch documentary, especially if you belong to the hacker culture
